mapper.select:
SELECT L.*, O.OrderName, O.OrderState, Ch.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPayLog L LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderPay OPay ON L.PgTradeNo = OPay.PgTradeNo INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON L.OrderNo = O.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON O.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode
AND L.OrderNo = #{pOrderNo}
AND (L.RegistDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND L.RegistDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
ORDER BY L.LogId DESC
